metrics.served_estimator: milestone_frequency (training-group service frequency at the nearest 10,000 km milestone, smoothed towards prevalence)
metrics.baseline: prevalence (training positive rate for every visit)

maintenance_model.reason: Service-need model did not meet the acceptance criteria; see evaluation.json.

engine_condition_experiment.reason: The meaning of engine_condition (0/1) is undocumented, there is no source or licence, and rows cannot be grouped by engine or vehicle, so held-out scores may overstate performance on new vehicles. The fleet database also holds none of these live sensor readings.

synthetic_signal_audit.reason: Models do not beat the prevalence baseline (ROC-AUC near 0.5, R-squared near 0): the labels are independent of every input, consistent with randomly generated data. Training on them would produce a model that outputs noise, so both datasets are excluded from every served model.

cvffad_fault_system_experiment.task: fault_system (7 systems) from operating readings and vehicle context
cvffad_fault_system_experiment.reason: Every CVFFAD record is marked source='generated' and the dataset covers Chinese commercial trucks/vans with a placeholder DOI. Patterns learned from generated events must not be presented as real fleet risk.

diesel_dtc_presence_experiment.task: any active DTC (excluding P0000) from 11 OBD-II PIDs
diesel_dtc_presence_experiment.reason: DTCs are constant per vehicle, so labels identify the vehicle. With only one fault-free signature the vehicle-disjoint evaluation cannot support a fault detector; the fleet also has no live PID stream.

carobd_sensor_anomaly_v1.reason: Evaluated experiment kept from its own pipeline; not connected to fleet inference.

nasa_battery_cell_rul_1p4ah.reason: Evaluated experiment kept from its own pipeline; not connected to fleet inference.

diesel_airpath_fault_classifier_v1.task: Classify ten documented air-path conditions (healthy, MAF drift, MAP drift, EGR valve clog) from one row of signals
diesel_airpath_fault_classifier_v1.reason: Faults are injected, on data with no documented source, so scores do not establish real-world performance. Inputs are standardized with an unknown reference and include EGR and turbo signals an inspection does not record. All faulted runs share one route, so the holdout does not test generalization to other routes.
known_limitations: Faults are injected, on data with no documented source, so scores do not establish real-world performance.
Inputs are standardized with an unknown reference and include EGR and turbo signals an inspection does not record.
All faulted runs share one route, so the holdout does not test generalization to other routes.
cycles.json states that Cycle_RDE_Eifel2 drives the same route as Cycle_RDE_Eifel, so test results overstate performance on new routes.
If the supplied standardization used test rows, a small amount of leakage cannot be excluded.

scania_component_x_repair_window_v1.task: Repair of anonymized Component X within 48 time steps of a truck's last readout
scania_component_x_repair_window_v1.dataset: SCANIA Component X (inferred attribution; no documentation present locally)
scania_component_x_repair_window_v1.reason: 'Component X' is anonymized, so it cannot be mapped to any of the eight assessment categories. Inputs are anonymized heavy-truck histogram counters that this fleet does not collect. Trained on heavy trucks; not validated on the passenger cars, SUVs, vans and motorcycles in this fleet.
known_limitations: 'Component X' is anonymized, so it cannot be mapped to any of the eight assessment categories.
Inputs are anonymized heavy-truck histogram counters that this fleet does not collect.
Trained on heavy trucks; not validated on the passenger cars, SUVs, vans and motorcycles in this fleet.
Model scores are uncalibrated and are not failure probabilities.
Time steps are anonymized units, so the horizon cannot be stated in days or kilometres.

versions.task: Verified fault within 90 days of an assessment

report.methodology: Chronological holdout: the latest assessments are the test set and are scored once. Training uses only earlier assessments whose outcomes were also known before the test period began. The threshold and algorithm are chosen on an earlier validation period, never on the test set.

false_negative_analysis.note: Each of these is a verified fault this model would not have flagged.

acceptance_criteria.name: Healthy outcomes in the test period

decision_reasons: Passed every criterion. An administrator must review it before it can serve predictions.
